Fixes dev-skill-up/pitboss#448

## Plan

Rows (each Done-when bullet word for word from the ticket body, with its evidence; the commands first, the pointers to CI last).

1. `git rev-parse HEAD`
2. Done when 5: After the fix, `uvx --from . pitboss slots next dev-skill-up/pitboss#311 --config CFG 2>/dev/null | head -1` prints a `NEXT k of n` line for a ticket that an open pull request's Plan only mentions: `taken` in `work.py` counts a ticket as taken only when the pull request fixes it (the `Fixes` or `Closes` form, or its branch), never for a mention in a Plan or an Evidence block (Opus ruling 2026-11-11 00:17Z on pitboss PR 452, row 4). Run as one command, the lines of its output in this order (empty for #311, UNKNOWN on main for #444, NEXT on the branch for #444): `(uvx --from . pitboss slots next dev-skill-up/pitboss#311 --config /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/cfg/quire.toml 2>/dev/null | head -1); (cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/m448 && uvx --from . pitboss slots next dev-skill-up/pitboss#444 --config /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/cfg/quire.toml 2>&1 | grep -m1 '^UNKNOWN'); uvx --from . pitboss slots next dev-skill-up/pitboss#444 --config /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/cfg/quire.toml 2>/dev/null | head -1`. Impossible: `uvx --from . pitboss slots next dev-skill-up/pitboss#311 --config /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/cfg/quire.toml 2>/dev/null | head -1` -> (empty output), because #311 is closed (PR 454 merged). The same thing on live data with dev-skill-up/pitboss#444, an open ticket that an open PR only mentions: on main `cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/m448 && uvx --from . pitboss slots next dev-skill-up/pitboss#444 --config /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/cfg/quire.toml 2>&1 | grep -m1 '^UNKNOWN'` prints UNKNOWN (an open PR already works on it), and on the branch `uvx --from . pitboss slots next dev-skill-up/pitboss#444 --config /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/da1996b1-7fe2-5742-a481-c46311328875/scratchpad/cfg/quire.toml 2>/dev/null | head -1` prints `NEXT 4 ... start a PR: dev-skill-up/pitboss#444`.
3. CI (Done when 1): `uvx pitboss slots next` ranks pwa#313 at the place of the quire#1083 line it blocks, with the blocked ticket's priority and age. Workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_it_takes_the_place_of_the_ticket_that_waits`. The run is found for the commit by the check runs of the head SHA (`gh api repos/dev-skill-up/pitboss/commits/<head SHA>/check-runs`, or the run and job URL `actions` gives for the head): the matrix job's displayed name is `tests-3.13 on Python 3.13`.
4. CI (Done when 2): `uvx pitboss slots next bats-lang/pwa#313 --config CFG` prints its brief, not UNKNOWN. Workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_its_brief_is_printed`. The run is found for the commit by the check runs of the head SHA (`gh api repos/dev-skill-up/pitboss/commits/<head SHA>/check-runs`, or the run and job URL `actions` gives for the head): the matrix job's displayed name is `tests-3.13 on Python 3.13`.
5. CI (Done when 3): When a ticket is not queued, the UNKNOWN line names the reason (its labels, its state, the item it blocks). Workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_a_ticket_with_no_label_that_blocks_nothing` and `test_a_closed_ticket_with_labels`. The run is found for the commit by the check runs of the head SHA (`gh api repos/dev-skill-up/pitboss/commits/<head SHA>/check-runs`, or the run and job URL `actions` gives for the head): the matrix job's displayed name is `tests-3.13 on Python 3.13`.
6. CI (Done when 4): For a PR whose failed check is `canonical-files` and whose log has the line `not canonical: its sha256 <hash> is not listed for it in tools/pin-audit/allowlist.txt`, `slots next` prints that allowlist line from the log (the text after `the hash of this file as the next hash:`) and ranks a repository-prototype ticket for adding it at the PR's place, before any "fix the CI" worker line for the PR; an open repository-prototype pull request that already has the line is named instead, and the PR is a wait. Workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_the_ticket_takes_the_place_of_the_pull_request` and `test_the_open_pull_request_is_a_wait`. The run is found for the commit by the check runs of the head SHA (`gh api repos/dev-skill-up/pitboss/commits/<head SHA>/check-runs`, or the run and job URL `actions` gives for the head): the matrix job's displayed name is `tests-3.13 on Python 3.13`.
7. CI (Done when 5, the case): the PR of a Plan that only mentions a ticket does not take it. Workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_taken_and_offered` and `test_a_mention_in_a_plan_does_not_take_the_ticket`. The run is found for the commit by the check runs of the head SHA (`gh api repos/dev-skill-up/pitboss/commits/<head SHA>/check-runs`, or the run and job URL `actions` gives for the head): the matrix job's displayed name is `tests-3.13 on Python 3.13`.

## Execution

- `pullnames.names` (the one place `work.taken` and the item brief read) counts a ticket only for a `Fixes` or `Closes` form in a title or body, or a branch ending in its number; a mention in a Plan or an Evidence block names nothing. The timeline mention of the item brief (`itempick._crossed`) counts only an open PR that fixes the ticket. This is why a blocker named in a Plan was never offered (`dependency.settle` skips the `taken` tickets).
- `unqueued.why` adds the state, the labels and the items the ticket blocks to the UNKNOWN line of the whole order.
- `allowlistmiss` reads the log of a failed `canonical-files` check, takes the allowlist line after `the hash of this file as the next hash:`, and `pullmarks` makes such a PR blocked by the open repository-prototype PR that adds the line, else by the open ticket `Make <repository>'s workflow and issue-template files canonical`, which the existing dependency rule ranks at the PR's place; the `BLOCKED` line ends with `; allowlist line: <line>`.
- Ticket 311 of Done-when 5 is closed, so its command cannot print a `NEXT` line on live data (Opus ruling 6787006370: Plan row 2 revised as `Impossible: <command> -> (empty output)`); the same case is shown on live data with dev-skill-up/pitboss#444 in row 2, and is the test of row 7.
- The docstrings of `taken`, `ticket_items` and `work.py` now say a PR takes a ticket only by fixing it (a `Fixes` or `Closes` form, or its branch), and `test_the_ticket_takes_the_place_of_the_pull_request` asserts the exact list of starts, `["owner/project#1", TICKET]`, so the place of the ticket is tested (Opus ruling 6807088468).
- Local check: `pitboss nox` on the head: skills, lint, mypy and tests-3.13 all success.

Deviations: `pitboss nox` was run more than once on the work (lint, mypy and coverage failures fixed between runs, and the merge of main at the head); row 2's command prints nothing because ticket 311 is closed.
